sentences.text: Police Station Kurwai registered FIR at Crime No.47 of 2024 for offence punishable under Section 363 of IPC against unknown person.
During course of investigation, the victim was recovered on 13-03-2024 and her statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C was recorded.
She stated that she had friendly relations with Neelesh Kushwah (applicant).
Her parents were trying to get her married to some other person, therefore, on 13-02-2024 around 07:00 in the evening, she went with the applicant to Bhopal at her own will.
They married in a temple.
They rented a room in Bhopal and stayed there for about 20 days, thereafter, they returned to Village Sadher.
She is pregnant for one month.
On such allegations, prosecution for offence punishable under Sections 366, 376(2) of IPC and Sections 5L/6 of the POCSO Act was added.
The applicant was arrested on 14-03-2024.
Investigation is underway.
Learned Counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that applicant has been falsely implicated in the case under the pressure of family of the victim.
The AADHAR Card and birth certificate which was shown to the applicant by the victim mentions her date of birth as 01-01-2004, therefore, she was major at the time of alleged incident.
Jail incarceration is causing hardship to both applicant as well as victim, who is residing with the family of applicant.
The parents of applicant are looking after the pregnant victim.
There is no likelihood of absconsion of applicant leaving his family and home.
There is no likelihood of his tampering with evidence.
The trial would take time to conclude.
Therefore, applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
Per contra, learned Counsel for State opposes the bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.
